name: @pipeworx/mcp-tavily

tools.name: search
tools.description: AI/LLM-optimized web search built for RAG: returns a synthesized natural-language answer plus a ranked list of sourced results (title, url, content snippet, relevance score). Prefer this over scraping a generic search engine when you need grounded, citable web context. Example: search({ query: "latest SpaceX Starship test result" })

query.description: The search query / question to research.

search_depth.description: Search depth: "basic" (fast, default) or "advanced" (deeper, more thorough).

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5, max 20).

topic.description: Search topic: "general" (default) or "news" for recent news coverage.

include_answer.description: Whether to include a synthesized AI answer string (default true).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Tavily API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: tavily_news
tools.description: Recent NEWS coverage with FULL ARTICLE TEXT — "latest news about <company/person/topic>", "news coverage of X this week", "what are people reporting about X", "recent headlines on X". Returns a synthesized answer plus ranked articles each carrying title, url, publication content, and a relevance score — the full text, not just a headline, so the calling agent can quote and cite. Freshness-windowed via `days` (default 7). This is the premium news path (Tavily, funded key, no per-IP throttle, no shared free-tier quota); prefer it when the question asks what is being REPORTED about a specific entity or topic.

query.description: The entity or topic to get news about, e.g. "Anthropic", "GLP-1 drug pricing".

days.description: How many days back to search (default 7, max 30).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Tavily API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Extract clean article text from one or more URLs via Tavily: strips boilerplate/navigation and returns up to 20,000 chars of readable content per page. Accepts a single URL string or an array. Ideal for feeding source pages into an LLM.

urls.description: A single URL string, or an array of URL strings, to extract clean text from.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Tavily API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-tavily forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the tavily pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
